messages:
Olivia: quick postmortem follow-up on last night's cross-region LB retry spike. Summarizing owners & timelines below — please ack and raise blockers now.

Sam: ack, thanks. can you paste the short TL;DR of root cause?

Jason: TL;DR: asymmetric route announcements + late egress path selection caused repeated TLS handshake attempts and connection requeues across regions. Edge logs showed repeated handshake timeouts and SYN retransmits. Example:
```
2026-03-22T02:14:12Z edge-01 lb-route: TLS handshake timeout after 3s for conn id=0x7f9c
2026-03-22T02:14:12Z edge-01 net: retransmit syn id=0x7f9c attempts=4
2026-03-22T02:14:13Z edge-02 lb-probe: route-probe mismatch: announced via us-east-1, accepted us-west-2
```
This led to a temporary backoff spiral as connections retried to the 'wrong' region and hit short-lived TLS failures.

Priya: proposed action items (owners + dates):
1) Jason -> fix announce sequence in control-plane to avoid transient asymmetric announce (patch + canary) — ETA Thu 03/26 EOD.
2) Maya -> add an e2e cross-region smoke + deterministic repro harness (include TLS handshake timing variance) — ETA Tue 03/24.
3) Sam -> dashboard + alert tuning: add `lb.cross_region.retry_rate` panel, reduce noisy pager by adjusting threshold + mute known benign patterns — ETA Mon 03/23.
4) Olivia -> coordinate release playbook, update runbook with rollback and canary gates, and schedule follow-up meeting — ETA Fri 03/27.

Jason: I'll open a PR today with the announce ordering fix. Putting a canary flag behind `route.stable_announce` so we can rollout. Est: 2 dev days + 1 day of canary.

Maya: I'll extend the route-probe harness to replay the exact announce ordering and inject handshake delays. Plan to run against prod-shadow region and a small canary pool. Need sig-infra role to run shadow jobs.

Sam: I'll create the Grafana panel and an alert: `WHEN lb.cross_region.retry_rate > 5% FOR 5m` create alert severity=warning, pager only if > 8% for 5m. Linking dashboard (internal): https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234.

infra-bot: Runbook updated 📄 — https://internal/runbooks/cross-region-backoff (updated by Olivia).

Olivia: owners & dates reiterated: Jason(03/26), Maya(03/24), Sam(03/23), Olivia(03/27). Add any downstream dependent tickets now. We'll meet Fri 10:30am PT for final signoff — calendar invite incoming.

Jason: ack :thumbsup: — PR will reference this thread.

Maya: ack, requesting infra role now — @infra please approve.

Sam: ack — will post panel link and alert IDs when done.

Priya: adding these to the postmortem action tracker and marking as P0 -> follow-up.

Olivia: also note: this appears to be a recurring pattern across the last 3 months (see routing regression board). Sam/Priya, can you add the pattern to the weekly incident trends so we can measure recurrence rate?

Sam: will add a trend graph: `routing.regressions.count` with tags [tls, cross-region, lb].

Priya: adding to the routing regression board and linking to the postmortem doc. If owners slip, escalate to network-eng leads.

infra-bot: Scheduler: follow-up meeting created for 2026-03-26T17:30:00Z (15m) — invite sent.

Olivia: final quick checks — if canary fails, rollback plan is: revert `route.stable_announce` flag, failover to local-region sticky routing, and open an incident. Owners, please mark this thread when tasks are complete.

Jason: will mark here once PR merges and canary hits > 30k tokens.

Maya: once harness ready I'll run 3 consecutive blue/green runs and post logs.

Sam: dashboard + alert created, alert ID: alert-6792. Posting link in tracker.

Priya: noted — keeping this in the weekly cadence.

Olivia: last check-in before wrap: all owners confirmed, follow-up meeting scheduled, tracking in action tracker. Closing initial follow-up loop; will reopen if canary shows regressions.
